acip: ,RNAM PA GANG ZAG GI BDAG TU LTA BA NGO BO NYON MONGS PA CAN YIN PAS SGRIB PA YIN LA DGE BA DANG MI DGE BA GANG DU'ANG LUNG DU MA BSTAN PA,
wylie: rnam pa gang zag gi bdag tu lta ba ngo bo nyon mongs pa can yin pas sgrib pa yin la dge ba dang mi dge ba gang du'ang lung du ma bstan pa
english: The aspect that this state of mind then takes is that of perceiving some self-nature to the person.  As its very essence thus is to involve negative emotions, negative consciousness functions to block us from spiritual progress.  It is though, further, karmically neutral—which is to say, it was not clarified as being either a good deed or a bad deed.
